events.title: CM Seminar: Dr. Elena Agapie – “Centering Users in Health Technologies: Balancing People’s Practices with Health Interventions in Design”
events.description:
CMPM 26-27 Seminar

Welcome to the fourth Computational Media seminar of the fall quarter. Open to all, class enrollment is not required. Food will be provided.

Please join us in-person at E2-280 or via Zoom to learn more about the works of Dr. Elena Agapie:

Title: Centering Users in Health Technologies: Balancing People’s Practices with Health Interventions in Design

events.title: Career Coaching in the Courtyard – Drop-in Coaching at Baskin Engineering – Week 8
events.description:
Do you have any questions or need some insight on your internship/job search? Perhaps you want someone to take a look at your resume or LinkedIn and offer advice? Or maybe you’d just like to explore different career options with a coach? Baskin Engineering’s Career Engagement Specialist, Erin Busch, will be hanging out at Baskin Engineering’s courtyard for casual career coaching on Monday, November 16th from 4:30pm – 5:30pm, feel free to stop by with any career related question.

Bring a friend!

venue.venue: Jack Baskin School of Engineering (E1), Baskin Courtyard (main courtyard between JBE & E2), Santa Cruz, California, United States
